summaryPoints.text: Northfield Physical Therapy pays $120 a month for Pinecrest's scheduling software, and the price stays fixed unless both sides sign a new agreement.
sentences: Fee: $120 per month, billed monthly in advance.
The monthly fee stays at $120 for as long as this agreement is in effect, and any change to the fee requires a new agreement signed by both parties.

summaryPoints.text: The plan runs month to month, and you can cancel at any time with no cancellation fee.
sentences: This agreement runs month to month, starting on the Start Date.
Pinecrest does not charge any cancellation fee, and Customer owes nothing further after the paid month ends.

summaryPoints.text: You own your data and can download it at any time, including for 60 days after the agreement ends.
sentences: Customer owns all appointment records, client contact details and other information that Customer enters into the service.
